text:
maya: Quick check — we’re locking the SDK/docs/sampleapp trio for the release cutoff today at 17:00 PT. If you own any changelog entries or sampleapp deps that need a last-minute tweak, call it out here. I can merge critical docs tweaks only after lock. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

oli: Ok, heads up — I’ve got one breaking change in SDK v1.9.2: the `Client.stream()` signature changed. PR #842 is open, needs a quick review from @cheng. If we can’t land it, I’ll ship a compatibility shim. :thinking:

cheng: On it. Reviewing now. FYI sampleapp unit test is flapping after the shim merge earlier — looks like a race in the quickstart runner. Putting a fix in sampleapps/runner: add a small backoff. PR #597.

sam: Docs note — I trimmed the quickstart guide and added a short migration note for `Client.stream()` in docs/upgrade.md. I’ll hold off on large reorgs. If anyone needs a one-line clarification merged, ping me with the exact text. :white_check_mark:

lena: Sampleapp dependency blocker: we depend on `httpx==0.23` in samples/server; CI fails with 0.24. I can bump to `^0.24` but need an ok from eng-runtime since they validate our performance matrix. @oli please confirm runtime compatibility?

oli: Runtime compatibility looks fine for httpx 0.24 — I tested latency bench locally. Go ahead with the bump, but please add a quick perf note in the PR description.

cheng: Quick status: reviewed #842, left one small nit (naming). If @oli addresses it I can merge within 30m. Also merged sampleapps/runner#597 — added `await asyncio.sleep(0.05)` backoff; CI green locally. :shipit:

maya: Great. Workflow for changelog entries: please add a single-line bullet to CHANGELOG/unreleased.md using the format below. Only one bullet per PR. I’ll squash the doc edits at EOD.

---
Example entry format:
- sdk: Client.stream() signature changed to accept `stream_config` (PR #842) — @oli
---

lena: Added the httpx bump PR #614 with the perf note. Also updated sampleapp README to call out local env vars.

sam: Merging tiny docs fixes now (docs typo, anchor links). Will not change any anchors or move pages. If you need me to revert anything post-lock, DM me.

release-bot: automated: release window reminder — cutoff in 45m (2078903934). Please ensure all blocking PRs are queued and reviewers are assigned.

maya: Final ask — owners, drop a quick "LGTM" here when your last PR is queued/merged so I can tally. I’ll do the final changelog sweep 10m before cutoff. :eyes:

oli: LGTM — #842 queued with the naming fix, reviewer assigned.

cheng: LGTM — merged runner fix and reviewed #842.
